_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja EngineRoom/Maszynownia (75 terminow, ~19 mikroscen) - obszar Grippa z jego balonem/koszem, kartonowymi klientami, kolekcja kompasow oraz skrzynia z tajemniczym zwojem (mapa?). Silnik lodzi rowniez tutaj.
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci. Gripp rozpoznany jednoznacznie jako mowca w scenach dotyczacych jego kosza/kolekcji (charakterystyczny showmanski styl - 'Please! Peruse at your leisure.').

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_BG/Section.en: I thought you were talking about me...
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_BG/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_BasketNoPer.en: Do you think there's anything in there?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_BasketNoPer.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_BasketNoPer.en: It's a basket for a hot air balloon.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_BasketNoPer.pl: To kosz balonu na ogrzane powietrze.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_BasketNoPer.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_BasketNoPer.en:
I can [h]see[/h] what's in there.
It's a human man.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_BasketNoPer.pl:
[h]Widzę[/h], co tam jest.
To mężczyzna, człowiek.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_BasketNoPer.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_BasketNoPer.en: Right. Let's talk to him first.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_BasketNoPer.pl: No tak. Porozmawiajmy z nim najpierw.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_BasketNoPer.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_Cane/Sectio.en: Let's take a look at Gripp's cane.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_Cane/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_Initial/Sec.en: [i]I think there's someone in that basket...[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_Initial/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_LockedBoxEn.en: Yeah it did, I heard it.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_LockedBoxEn.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_LockedBoxSt.en: A selection of some of my more [h]unusual[/h] compasses.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_LockedBoxSt.speaker: Gripp

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_MapBoxClose.en: What about this box down here?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_MapBoxClose.pl: A co z tym pudełkiem tutaj?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_MapBoxClose.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_MapBoxClose.en: No need to touch that, thank you!
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_MapBoxClose.pl: Nie ma potrzeby tego dotykać, dziękuję!
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_MapBoxClose.speaker: Gripp

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_MapBoxOpen/.en:
That is [h]not[/h] for sale.
Please, don't touch it.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_MapBoxOpen/.pl:
To [h]nie[/h] jest na sprzedaż.
Proszę, nie dotykajcie tego.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_MapBoxOpen/.speaker: Gripp

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_MapBoxOpen/.en: What is that, some kind of scroll?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_MapBoxOpen/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_basket1/Sec.en: Gripp, can we take a look in the basket?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_basket1/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_basket1/Sec.en: Will you be getting [h]out[/h] of the basket?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_basket1/Sec.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_canvas/Sect.en:
I think so.
And it's branded with a logo.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_canvas/Sect.pl:
Chyba tak.
I jest oznaczony logo.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_canvas/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_canvas/Sect.en: ...is that the [h]balloon[/h] part of a hot air balloon?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_canvas/Sect.pl: ...czy to ta [h]balonowa[/h] część balonu na ogrzane powietrze?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_canvas/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_cog/Section.en:
[h]Grimoire.[/h]
What did I tell you when we first met?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_cog/Section.pl:
[h]Grimoire.[/h]
Co ci powiedziałam, gdy się poznaliśmy?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_cog/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_cog/Section.en: [i]That if I ever get stuck in a giant cog, you wouldn't pull me out.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_cog/Section.pl: [i]Że jeśli kiedykolwiek utknę w wielkim trybie, nie wyciągniesz mnie.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_cog/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_cog/Section.en: Maybe - maybe I should touch it?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_cog/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_customers1/.en: Just some of my satisfied customers.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_customers1/.speaker: Gripp

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_lamps/Secti.en: How many mystery writers does it take to change a lightbulb?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_lamps/Secti.pl: Ilu pisarzy kryminałów trzeba, żeby wymienić żarówkę?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_lamps/Secti.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_lamps/Secti.en: ...and the other to give it an unexpected twist.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_lamps/Secti.pl: ...a drugi, żeby dać jej nieoczekiwany zwrot akcji.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_lamps/Secti.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_machine/Sec.en: I thought you were talking about me.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_machine/Sec.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_salesign/Se.en: Can I buy something with my wages?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_salesign/Se.pl: Mogę kupić coś za moją pensję?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_salesign/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_salesign/Se.en: We don't get paid until we solve the mystery.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_salesign/Se.pl: Nie dostaniemy zapłaty, dopóki nie rozwiążemy tej zagadki.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_salesign/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_salesign/Se.en:
What if we don't solve it?
Do I still get paid?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_salesign/Se.pl:
A co, jeśli jej nie rozwiążemy?
Wciąż dostanę zapłatę?
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_salesign/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_wheel/Secti.en: If I turn [h]this[/h] wheel, you have to turn the other one.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_wheel/Secti.pl: Jeśli obrócę [h]to[/h] koło, ty musisz obrócić to drugie.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_wheel/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_wheel/Secti.en: Because one good turn deserves another.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_wheel/Secti.pl: Bo jeden dobry obrót zasługuje na drugi.
Examine/Exam_Area_EngineRoom_wheel/Secti.speaker: Grimoire
